Terms, Data Sources & Methodology

Independent Build Notice & Disclaimer

This portal is an independent engineering screening tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by SSE plc, Scottish and Southern Electricity Networks (SSEN Distribution / SSEN Transmission), or National Grid ESO.

All capacity estimates and feasibility ratings are indicative and for preliminary screening only. They do not constitute a formal Point of Connection (PoC) quote or grid reservation. Formal applications must be submitted directly to SSEN: ssen.co.uk/our-services/connections/.

Regulatory Data Sources

All 981 substations are sourced directly from official SSEN open datasets:

  • SSEN May 2026 Generation Availability Heatmaps: Coordinates, voltages, circuit breaker breaking and fault currents (SEPD: 5e44d9db..., SHEPD: 9700c765...).
  • SSEN May 2026 LTDS Table 3 & 7: Distribution firm capacities, peak demands, and 5-year forecasts (SEPD: 02c9431f..., SHEPD: 2bd2c3f3...).
  • SSEN May 2026 NSHR Reports: 2027–2050 multi-scenario headroom envelopes (SEPD: 6e1bf42b..., SHEPD: 3b368f36...).
  • SSEN May 2026 NDR Reports: GSP transmission reinforcement schemes (Part 2 Table 2).

Calculation Methodology

Implements SSEN DSO's Network Development Plan (NDP) methodology:

  • Demand Headroom: Firm Capacity (MVA) − Forecasted Maximum Demand (MVA) [NDP Sec 6.1].
  • Generation Headroom: Reverse Power Flow Rating (MVA) − Minimum Summer Load [NDP Sec 6.2].
  • Battery Storage Headroom: min(Demand Headroom, Generation Headroom) [Dual Constraint].
  • Post-Project Margin: Available Headroom − Requested Capacity.
